findings.evidence: "## Governance" opens about 75 lines of generic program management (CONTRIBUTING.md, Code of Conduct, PR templates, "**Office Hours**: Regular Q&A sessions", pre-launch and post-launch marketing items) through the end of the file
findings.fix: Cut Governance, Adoption & Maintenance, Pre-Launch and Post-Launch (lines 312-386) to the few items that gate design-system correctness; the model already knows generic program management, and by line count this dilutes the expert SKILL.md.

findings.evidence: "Select a high-frequency, high-failure-cost pattern with a real consuming screen."
findings.fix: Add a tie-breaker: when several patterns qualify equally, pick the one whose consuming screen is already scheduled for change this cycle, so adoption is measurable.

findings.evidence: "Ship a short component documentation guide with the starter: for each component, its purpose, props and variants, accessibility notes, and one usage example."
findings.fix: Move this to-do into workflow step 8; a gotchas entry should be a mistake with a reason, e.g. "Never document a component by example alone — list props and states, or consumers copy the example's exact prop set."

findings.evidence: "- Component source scaffold: `templates/component-template.tsx` (adapt semantic tokens and native semantics; do not copy blindly)."
findings.fix: Gate it like the other three resources: "Load templates/component-template.tsx only when scaffolding a brand-new component; otherwise compose from the existing hierarchy."

findings.evidence: "Check alias resolution, cycles, missing targets, and contrast for each actual foreground/background pair: 4.5:1 normal text, 3:1 large text and essential UI boundaries."
findings.fix: Name the verification method for this fragile check: computed-style assertions per theme and state (as in references/component-examples.md) or an axe contrast-rule run; thresholds alone leave the agent guessing how to measure.

findings.evidence: "Our legacy UI has low-contrast buttons, inconsistent spacing, and icon-only controls. Give an audit-and-migration plan that avoids a risky big-bang rewrite."
findings.fix: Add a small legacy-UI fixture under evals/files/ (a page with hardcoded hex values and icon-only buttons) and reference it in the eval's files so audit assertions are checkable against an actual input.

findings.evidence: "Integrate into representative screens including the most constrained consumer. Check keyboard, focus, zoom, contrast, responsive behavior, and brand/theme variations."
findings.fix: State the no-rig fallback: when the project has no component test setup, do a keyboard-only and 200%-zoom pass on the pilot screen and say so, instead of leaving the check undefined.
